count-next.instruction: Count forward through the shown numbers. Choose the number that comes next.

pattern-next.instruction: Look at the repeating objects. Choose the object that comes next.

sort-round.instruction: Choose every round object. You can choose more than one.

place-beside.instruction: Choose the position that means beside the tree.

longest-rope.instruction: Compare the rope lengths. Choose the longest rope.

sound-s.instruction: Listen to the /s/ sound. Choose the letter that represents /s/.

word-cat.instruction: Use the letter tiles to build the label for a small pet that meows.

word-sun.instruction: Use the letter tiles to build the label for the bright object in the daytime sky.

word-map.instruction: Use the letter tiles to build the label for a drawing that shows places and paths.

seed-order.instruction: Put the story cards in order: first, next, then last.

listen-direction.instruction: Ask a helper or narration to say: put the cup beside the tree. Choose the matching direction.

read-red-cup.instruction: Read the message: Pip needs a red cup. Choose the matching message.
